data.name: Ramir
data.gender_notes: Ramir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is high, exalted, and strong. The name Ramir carries the meaning “High, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Ramir usually hope their child will grow to embody high, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those seeking spiritual growth and strength in their faith.
data.etymology: Ramir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “High, Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramir total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: رَمِير
in_arabic.long_meaning: يُشير الاسم إلى الفرد الذي يمتلك قيمة عالية، ويُعتبر مثالاً للمثالية، ويُرفع على غيره. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للتعبير عن الشخص الذي يحظى باحترام الجميع، ويُعتبر مصدر إلهام. في القرآن الكريم، لا يوجد ذكر مباشر للاسم، لكنه يُشابَه في بعض الآيات التي تتحدث عن الأوصياء الذين يتمتعون بذكاء وإنصاف وقوة، ويُعتبرون مصدرًا للتعلم والثناء.

in_urdu.name: رَمیر
in_urdu.meaning: بالائی ہونے والا، مثالی ہونے والا، رفيع ہونے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اس نام کا مطلب ہے ایک بالائی، مثالی، رفيع شخص جو دنیا میں بلند پایہ ہوتا ہے۔ اس نام کی روایت عربی زبان سے لگتی ہے۔ اس سے مراد ایک ایسا شخص ہے جو اپنے اعمال سے دوسروں کو عبرت حاصل کرائے اور ان کی اہمیت پر روشنی ڈالے۔ اس کے معنی میں عربی لفظ "رام" کا مطلب ہے "بالائی" اور "مثالی" اور "رفيع"۔ اس نام کی ترویج جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں نے کی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रमीर
in_hindi.meaning: उच्च होने वाला, आदर्श होने वाला, ऊंच होने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम का अर्थ है एक उच्च, आदर्श, ऊंच व्यक्ति, जो दुनिया में उच्च दर्जे की होती है। इस नाम की परंपरा अरबी भाषा से जुड़ी हुई है। इसका अर्थ है एक ऐसा व्यक्ति जो अपने कार्यों से दूसरों को उदाहरण देता है और उनकी महत्ता को उजागर करता है। इस नाम के अर्थ में अरबी शब्द "राम" का अर्थ है "उच्च" और "आदर्श" और "ऊंच"। इस नाम को भारतीय मुसलमानों ने अपनाया है।

in_pashto.name: رَمیر
in_pashto.meaning: بالایي ګرل، مېړانه ګرل، پښتانه ګرل
in_pashto.long_meaning: دې نوم دا پېښتنو ټولنه کې د ښځينه په بڼه ترسره کېږي، له هغه څخه دا ښځینه چې د پښتنو ټولنه کې د لوېديځې ټولنې په پرتله ډېرې لوړې مقام درلودې. دې نوم په افغانستان کې د پښتنو ځوړو کې ترسره کېږي، دې نوم ته د افغانستان په ټولنه کې د لوړ مقام، عطا، او زړه پورته کول په مانا اټکل کېږي.

in_english.name: Ramir
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ramir is derived from the Arabic root "ram," meaning "high," "ideal," and "noble." In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with the qualities of a high-ranking individual who is respected and admired by others. The name is also found in Ottoman Turkish literature, where it is used to describe a person of high standing and noble character. In modern usage, the name Ramir is often given to children born into Muslim families, where it is seen as a symbol of excellence and dignity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ramir" in Islamic culture represents a person of high social status, power, and strength. It is a name that implies respect, dignity, and admiration from others. In Islamic societies, individuals with names like Ramir are often seen as leaders, protectors, and pillars of their communities. This name reflects the values of courage, honor, and resilience, which are highly prized in Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ramir holds deeper meaning. It implies a connection to the Almighty Allah, who is the ultimate source of power, strength, and exaltation. The name is a reminder of the verses in the Quran that say, "And by the morning [it is said], 'Your Lord is Forgiving, Merciful' and by the night, 'Your Lord is Forgiving, Loving.' And indeed, the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk the earth in peace and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace. And those who spend [in Allah's cause] in the night and ask forgiveness from their Lord and [ancies] for the attainment of His pleasure and who spend from what We have bestowed on them, secretly and openly, and who restrain anger – it is those who are the best fulfillers of religion [and are] righteous." (Quran 26:62-67) Thus, the name "Ramir" serves as a reminder to strive towards the spiritual qualities of forgiveness, peacemaking, generosity, restraint, and righteousness. It urges the bearer to connect with Allah and seek His pleasure in all aspects of life.
